model_name: Orbital Economy v7.7.4 r1 — Capital Goods Capital
notes: v7.7.4: capital-goods production capacity is capital on the lifecycle kernel (a kernel-v2 plant per colony, as the v7.7.3 construction-materials plant), sized to a new smoothed capital-goods demand-signal stock. See docs/tasks/014-capital-goods-capital/.

Modes 0-35 reproduce v7.7.3 r1 exactly (Capital Goods Capital Enabled = 0); Mode 36 baseline (A plant grows past its starting capacity), Mode 37 transport surge in which colony B rebuilds its capital-goods plant.
Exact numbers are defined on the canonical platform (docs/VERSIONING_AND_AUTHORITY.md section 8); series-digest.windows.json is the golden.
